title: NA40011: Marine Maintenance And Repairs
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Maintenance requirements - corrosion, fatigue, marine fouling; Failure causes fatigue failure of structural members, deformation failures, failure due to
corrosion; Repairs to failures - Measures for failure of structural members due
to deformation, corrosion, fatigue, etc; Design considerations with regard to
maintenance; Maintenance scheduling; Corrosion mechanism of steel - design
aspects and prevention techniques; Welding repair decision modelClassification requirements of hull survey, identification of defects in plates
and welds; Underwater welding - dry and wet Welding, effect on weld composition
and weld quality; Impact of preventive maintenance and repair techniques on
operation.
